mentions.name: Fairway Rogue
mentions.description: A procedurally generated, deck-building, mini-golf roguelite video game, released on iOS with an Android release still in progress. Development included building internal tools to help balance the game's mechanics.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've always wanted to make a video game, and over the past few months have been building one, Fairway Rogue.  It's a procedurally generated, deck-building, mini-golf roguelite.
